stem: Who was elected the President of Indian National Congress in 1938?
expl: Subash Chandra Bose was elected President of Congress in Haripura Session (Gujarat) of February, 1938 A.D., unopposed. It is well known that Subhash Chandra Bose was re-elected as President of Tripuri Session (1939 A.D.) of INC by defeating re-elected Pattabhi Sitaramayya (who was supported by Gandhiji).

stem: Subhas Chandra Bose was chosen President of Congress in Tripuri Session of Indian National Congress in the year 1939. Where is Tripuri?
expl: Tripuri is situated in Jabalpur (Madhya Pradesh) where Congress Session of 1939 A.D. was held. In Tripuri Session, Subhas Chandra Bose was elected President by defeating Pattabhi Sitaramayya with 1580 votes over 1377 votes.

stem: In which of the following sessions of Indian National Congress was Subhash Chandra Bose elected as President for the second time?
expl: In Haripura Session of Congress 1938 A.D., S.C. Bose was elected President (unopposed) for the fi rst time. He was re-elected as President in Tripuri Session, 1939 A.D. defeating Pattabhi Sitaramayya supported by Gandhi but on the question of the formation of Working Committee, the dispute between Gandhi and Bose came to the surface. After that, Bose resigned, and Dr. Rajendra Prasad became President of Congress.

stem: Which Indian nationalist leader looked upon a war between Germany and Britain as a godsend opportunity which would enable Indians to exploit the situation to their advantage?
